title: Vardar
description: A Bulgarian rhapsody built on folk dance rhythms, by Vladigerov, the country’s best-known composer of the 1900s. Bulgaria Hall is home to the Sofia Philharmonic.

title: Kalimankou Denkou
description: A folk song arranged for the women’s choir of Bulgarian state radio, from the album that a Swiss producer released in 1975 as “The Mystery of Bulgarian Voices.”
